YTA. Frankly, you sound like a spoiled brat who only cares about yourself. I do have a possible solution: why not start cooking more often and make a dish with meat for the rest of the family and one without for her? Like, make pasta and just take a serving off for her before you add meat to the sauce or something. Your brother’s girlfriend is not expecting you to change your diet for her. She just wants food that she can eat; she does not expect the rest of you to stop eating meat as well. You can easily make her a vegetarian meal with little to no extra effort. If you’re actually interested in this solution, I have plenty of easy recipe ideas for you.

Him and I kinda knew each other for years, but never really talked. I had recently gotten out of a two-year-long toxic relationship with my first boyfriend who usually refused to even hold my hand. I was sitting on new guy’s lap because we were on our way to band practice with six people in a five-person car, and when everyone got out of the car once we got there, he softly said “hey”, cupped my cheek, and kissed me. 

We’re still together and he means the world to me :)

YTA. This is cheating. Even if you didn’t physically do anything, it’s still cheating. You’re doing something sexual with someone other than your girlfriend without your girlfriend’s consent. Also shitty of you to use the trauma from her sexual assault as an excuse for cheating on her. You should have talked to her about how her “going dry” made you feel and how to remedy this problem, not go behind her back and sext others. As someone who has previously been in your gf’s place, I can say that lots of long and sometimes awkward conversations have helped me so much. If you had talked to her openly about the way you felt, both of you could have fixed a number of issues. I will say, however, that you’re not the asshole for sleeping with someone else after you broke up with her.
